requirements.statement: Each router shall replay the active double-buffered calendar bank as a sparse ordered event list of up to 128 entries per bank. Each entry is {slot[9:0], valid[0], in_port[2:0], out_port_mask[4:0], opcode[3:0]} packed to 23 bits, sorted by slot. Calendar ID is 2 bits and an epoch bit selects the bank; only the inactive bank is writable and activation occurs atomically at slot 0 after old-epoch retirement. Dispatch uses next-event match: when global slot counter equals entry.slot, the calendar path fires.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Unchanged from Trial 3/4 SparseCal. Measured allreduce m=1 max 49 entries/router; depth 128 provides >2× margin. Storage 2×128×23=5,888 bits.
acceptance_criteria: BFM replaying all valid sparse entries fires exactly at entry.slot with encoded ingress, mask, and opcode.
Active bank is never written; no mixed-epoch replay.
Total calendar storage per router is exactly 2 x 128 x 23 = 5,888 bits.
Loader rejects duplicate (router, slot) entries and out-of-range ports/masks.

requirements.statement: Calendar replay shall use event-owned zero-buffer forwarding on slot match via CalFork, while BG and escape traffic use a credited XY-DOR class on non-matching cycles (soft priority). Calendar wins when a matching sparse event fires; BG never displaces a firing calendar event. Conservative hard 1-in-16 bound remains 328 cycles on 12-hop worst case; soft-priority reserve-covered bound is approximately 160 cycles; soft + shared-pool contention bound is approximately 188 cycles.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Soft priority retained; SharedPool size 28 updates pool-contention bound to ~188 without weakening calendar isolation.
acceptance_criteria: Mixed legal-calendar/BG BFM observes no cyclic wait; BG routes X before Y.
BG never grants over a firing calendar event at the same cycle.
Conservative 12-hop bound (|dx|=5, |dy|=7) ≤ 328 cycles under hard-TDM premises.
Soft-prio reserve-covered 12-hop bound ≤ 160 cycles under max-occupancy-49 premise.
Soft+pool contention bound ≤ 188 cycles under documented adversarial assumptions.

requirements.statement: Calendar payloads shall have no queued VC storage and shall never consume the shared BG pool. BG/escape payload buffering shall use a shared buffer pool of 28 flits plus per-port reserve of 2 flits (5×2=10), totaling 38 flits (19,456 bits) per interior router. Enqueue is allowed if the port still has unused reserve or shared_used < 28. Per-egress credit counters enforce 16 flits horizontal and 20 flits vertical. Demote/escape traffic uses pool/reserves losslessly.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Trial 5 aggressive SharedPool: 28+2=38 still satisfies deadlock freedom (reserve=2 + XY-DOR) and RefC progress tests; pool 24+2 documented as sensitivity.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Larger area; Trial 5 area goal requires further cut.
Risk of port starvation / progress failure.
RefC PASS but less burst margin; kept as sensitivity only.

requirements.upstream_compliance: REQ-F-008 no-overwrite; REQ-P-001 rate; deadlock freedom documented in architecture.md.
acceptance_criteria: Credit counters never allow egress occupancy beyond allocated H/V depth.
test_shared_pool PASS: one port may take reserve+shared; other ports retain reserve when shared exhausted.
Calendar path never enqueues into the shared pool.
Demote escape enqueues into pool/reserves without drop when capacity exists.
No circular wait on pool credits under XY-DOR + per-port reserve.
BG_SHARED_POOL_SIZE==28 and BG_TOTAL_FLITS==38 in RefC.

requirements.statement: Trial 5 shall implement DCA Tier A only: reduce = calendar gather + PE-local compute; allreduce = gather + PE-local compute + calendar broadcast. The router shall not instantiate combine_unit or any DCA datapath/interface.
requirements.resolution_rationale: USER_CONFIRMED; reaffirmed from Trial 2/3/4. CalFork and SharedPool do not restore combine.
acceptance_criteria: Router RefC/BFM builds contain no combine_unit in the router datapath.
Reduce/allreduce calendar replays complete without router arithmetic results.
No DCA transaction interface is active for base-router operation.

requirements.statement: The router shall use a 32-cycle calendar watchdog after expected arrival and immediate early/wrong-port detection. A violation releases its calendar reservation exactly once, preserves the flit plus remaining 5-bit leaf mask, and emits one credited XY escape packet per unserved destination into the shared pool / reserves; recovery starts within two cycles when pool capacity is available.
requirements.resolution_rationale: No-drop graceful degradation; escape uses SharedPool-BG not calendar storage.
acceptance_criteria: Each violation class triggers exactly one reservation release.
Every remaining multicast leaf is delivered via escape/BG without loss.
Demotion action starts within 2 cycles once pool/reserve capacity exists.
test_demote_noloss and test_blocked_fork PASS.

requirements.statement: Analytic relative router area for Arch-A5 shall be strictly below Trial 4's 0.822× and inside or better than the 0.75–0.79× target band versus IQ-XY, using the audited component model in ppa-analytic.md with buffers 0.139 (38 flits), CalFork multicast 0.025, sparse calendar 0.009, and control 0.193.
requirements.resolution_rationale: Trial 5 dual levers: CalFork −0.033 and SharedPool −0.043 → 0.746×.
acceptance_criteria: ppa-analytic.md and ppa_analytic_model.py report Arch-A5 total area ≤ 0.79 and < 0.822.
Multicast component equals CalFork 0.025 (±0.005 band).
Buffer component reflects 38 flits (28+2).
Documented delta versus Trial 4 area is negative.

requirements.statement: Calendar multicast shall use CalFork: atomic expansion of the sparse-event out_port_mask[4:0] into all-or-nothing egress grants. The router shall not instantiate a general FlooNoC-class stream_fork engine or independent multi-stream fork FSMs for calendar traffic.
requirements.resolution_rationale: ADR-005: calendar already carries the mask; lean fork removes stream_fork area while preserving atomic multicast semantics.
acceptance_criteria: RefC calendar path uses cal_fork_expand / multicast_expand on out_port_mask only.
test_blocked_fork and calendar smoke PASS with atomic all-or-nothing semantics.
Analytic MC area modeled as CalFork 0.025, not FlooNoC 0.058.
